(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 SLAG TAPHOLE INDUCTION FREEZE-LINING STEFAN THERMAL EQUILIBRIUM SOLVER                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes 1D transient boundary phase change at taphole copper stave / molten slag bath.   *)
(* Preserves a protective autogenous skull (15-35 mm) against aggressive corrosive slag,    *)
(* dynamically balancing stave forced-water cooling against mid-frequency induction heating.*)

(* Calculate convective heat flux from liquid slag bath to solidus interface *)
IF rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC > rSlagLiquidusTemp_DegC THEN
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := rSlagConvectiveCoeff_Wm2K * (rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC - rSlagSolidusTemp_DegC);
ELSE
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := 1500.0; (* Minimum convective creep *)
END_IF;

(* Clamp thickness to prevent division by zero in conduction formula *)
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m < 0.002 THEN
    rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.002; (* 2mm minimum refractory skin *)
END_IF;

(* Calculate outward conductive heat flux extracted through frozen slag & copper stave *)
(* Total thermal resistance: R_total = (s_skull / k_skull) + (s_copper / k_copper) + (1 / h_coolant) *)
rHeatFluxOutward_Wm2 := (rSlagSolidusTemp_DegC - rTapholeCoolingReturnTemp_DegC) /
    ((rCalculatedLiningThickness_m / rSlagThermalConductivity_WmK) +
     (rCopperStaveThickness_m / rCopperStaveConductivity_WmK) +
     (1.0 / rCoolantHeatTransferCoeff_Wm2K));

(* Induction power energy deposition at taphole interior perimeter *)
(* P_induction deposits volumetric Joule heating in the near-boundary slag zone *)
IF bInductionActive AND (rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW > 0.0) THEN
    (* Effective surface heat flux equivalent: P_kW * 1000 / A_taphole (A_taphole approx 0.35 m2) *)
    rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 := rHeatFluxInward_Wm2 + (rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW * 1000.0 / 0.35);
END_IF;

(* Stefan phase change interface velocity: ds/dt = (Q_outward - Q_inward) / (rho * L_fus) *)
rStefanFrontVelocity_ms := (rHeatFluxOutward_Wm2 - rHeatFluxInward_Wm2) / (rSlagDensity_kgm3 * (rSlagLatentHeat_kJkg * 1000.0));

(* Integrate freeze-lining thickness over deterministic cycle time *)
rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := rCalculatedLiningThickness_m + (rStefanFrontVelocity_ms * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m > 0.080 THEN rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.080; END_IF; (* 80mm Max *)
IF rCalculatedLiningThickness_m < 0.001 THEN rCalculatedLiningThickness_m := 0.001; END_IF; (* 1mm Min *)
rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm := rCalculatedLiningThickness_m * 1000.0;

(* Closed-Loop Induction Coil Power Regulation for Freeze-Lining Equilibrium *)
IF bInductionPermissive AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 90) THEN
    bInductionActive := TRUE;
    (* If freeze lining is thicker than target, increase induction power to melt back *)
    (* Error = Estimated - Target *)
    rInduction_Integral := rInduction_Integral + (rInduction_Ki * (rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm - rFreezeLiningTarget_mm) * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rInduction_Integral > rInduction_MaxPower_kW THEN rInduction_Integral := rInduction_MaxPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInduction_Integral < 0.0 THEN rInduction_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    
    rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := (rInduction_Kp * (rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm - rFreezeLiningTarget_mm)) + rInduction_Integral;
    
    (* Viscosity Compensation Trim: high viscosity demands additional induction heat *)
    IF rTapholeSlagViscosity_Pas > 15.0 THEN
        rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW + ((rTapholeSlagViscosity_Pas - 15.0) * 3.5);
    END_IF;
    
    IF rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW > rInduction_MaxPower_kW THEN rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := rInduction_MaxPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW < 0.0 THEN rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    bInductionActive := FALSE;
    rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Taphole Copper Cooling Pump Control *)
rCoolingPump_Integral := rCoolingPump_Integral + (rCoolingPump_Ki * (rTapholeCopperTemp_DegC - 85.0) * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCoolingPump_Integral > 30.0 THEN rCoolingPump_Integral := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rCoolingPump_Integral < 5.0 THEN rCoolingPump_Integral := 5.0; END_IF;
rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := (rCoolingPump_Kp * (rTapholeCopperTemp_DegC - 85.0)) + rCoolingPump_Integral;
IF rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h > 30.0 THEN rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h < 5.0 THEN rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 5.0; END_IF;

(* Freeze-Lining Alarm Hazards *)
IF rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm < 8.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Freeze lining dangerously thin: erosion hazard *)
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm > 55.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Taphole choking / freeze-lock warning *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) SYNGAS RATIO & STOICHIOMETRIC REGULATOR               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Solves dynamic multivariable cross-coupling between Secondary Oxygen, Superheated Steam, *)
(* and Plasma DC Torch Power. Optimizes H2/CO molar ratio, gasifier freeboard temperature,   *)
(* dome pressure, and Syngas LHV via quadratic cost minimization over receding horizon.    *)

IF bAutoRatioMode AND bSystemRunning AND (iState >= 60) AND (iState < 90) THEN
    (* 4.1 Compute State Tracking Deviations *)
    rStateX_0 := rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC - rTargetFreeboardTemp_DegC;      (* Temp error [deg C] *)
    rStateX_1 := rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol - rTargetSyngasRatio_molmol;  (* Ratio error [mol/mol] *)
    rStateX_2 := rVotedVesselPressure_bar - rTargetVesselPress_bar;          (* Press error [bar] *)
    rStateX_3 := rSyngasLowerHeatingValue_MJNm3 - 8.50;                     (* LHV deviation [MJ/Nm3] *)
    
    (* 4.2 Disturbance Estimation (Waste Feed & Moisture Swings) *)
    rDistD_0 := (rSolidWasteFeedRate_kgh - 1500.0) / 1000.0;                (* Normalized feed disturbance *)
    rDistD_1 := (rWasteMoistureContent_pct - 20.0) / 10.0;                  (* Normalized moisture disturbance *)
    
    (* 4.3 State Space Prediction: x_next = A * x + B * u_delta + E * d *)
    (* Normalized Delta Control Inputs relative to operating nominals *)
    rPredX_0 := (rMatA_00 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_01 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_02 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_03 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_00 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_01 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_02 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_00 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_01 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_1 := (rMatA_10 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_11 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_12 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_13 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_10 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_11 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_12 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_10 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_11 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_2 := (rMatA_20 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_21 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_22 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_23 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_20 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_21 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_22 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_20 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_21 * rDistD_1);
                
    rPredX_3 := (rMatA_30 * rStateX_0) + (rMatA_31 * rStateX_1) + (rMatA_32 * rStateX_2) + (rMatA_33 * rStateX_3) +
                (rMatB_30 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rMatB_31 * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rMatB_32 * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) +
                (rMatE_30 * rDistD_0) + (rMatE_31 * rDistD_1);
                
    (* 4.4 Analytical Quadratic Cost Gradient: Grad_J = B^T * Q * x_pred + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
    rGradJ_0 := (rMatB_00 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_10 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_20 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_30 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_O2 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.01) + (rWeightS_O2 * (rControlU_0 - rControlU_Prev_0) * 0.05);
                
    rGradJ_1 := (rMatB_01 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_11 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_21 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_31 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_Steam * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.005) + (rWeightS_Steam * (rControlU_1 - rControlU_Prev_1) * 0.02);
                
    rGradJ_2 := (rMatB_02 * rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0) + (rMatB_12 * rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1) +
                (rMatB_22 * rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2) + (rMatB_32 * rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3) +
                (rWeightR_Torch * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.01) + (rWeightS_Torch * (rControlU_2 - rControlU_Prev_2) * 0.05);
                
    (* 4.5 Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
    rControlU_Prev_0 := rControlU_0;
    rControlU_Prev_1 := rControlU_1;
    rControlU_Prev_2 := rControlU_2;
    
    rControlU_0 := rControlU_0 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_0 * 450.0);
    rControlU_1 := rControlU_1 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_1 * 850.0);
    rControlU_2 := rControlU_2 - (rMpcStepSize * rGradJ_2 * 350.0);
    
    (* 4.6 Slew Rate Limiting Enforcement *)
    IF (rControlU_0 - rControlU_Prev_0) > (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_0 := rControlU_Prev_0 + (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_0 - rControlU_0) > (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_0 := rControlU_Prev_0 - (rMaxSlewO2_Nm3hs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    IF (rControlU_1 - rControlU_Prev_1) > (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_1 := rControlU_Prev_1 + (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_1 - rControlU_1) > (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_1 := rControlU_Prev_1 - (rMaxSlewSteam_kghs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    IF (rControlU_2 - rControlU_Prev_2) > (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_2 := rControlU_Prev_2 + (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec);
    ELSIF (rControlU_Prev_2 - rControlU_2) > (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec) THEN
        rControlU_2 := rControlU_Prev_2 - (rMaxSlewTorch_kWs * rCycleTime_sec);
    END_IF;
    
    (* 4.7 Hard Actuator Saturation Clamping *)
    IF rControlU_0 > rMaxO2Flow_Nm3h THEN rControlU_0 := rMaxO2Flow_Nm3h; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_0 < rMinO2Flow_Nm3h THEN rControlU_0 := rMinO2Flow_Nm3h; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_1 > rMaxSteamFlow_kgh THEN rControlU_1 := rMaxSteamFlow_kgh; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_1 < rMinSteamFlow_kgh THEN rControlU_1 := rMinSteamFlow_kgh; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_2 > rMaxTorchPower_kW THEN rControlU_2 := rMaxTorchPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rControlU_2 < rMinTorchPower_kW THEN rControlU_2 := rMinTorchPower_kW; END_IF;
    
    rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := rControlU_0;
    rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := rControlU_1;
    rTorchPowerDemand_kW := rControlU_2;
    
    (* 4.8 Compute Total Scalar MPC Objective Cost J *)
    rMpcObjectiveCost := (rWeightQ_Temp * rPredX_0 * rPredX_0) +
                         (rWeightQ_Ratio * rPredX_1 * rPredX_1) +
                         (rWeightQ_Press * rPredX_2 * rPredX_2) +
                         (rWeightQ_LHV * rPredX_3 * rPredX_3) +
                         (rWeightR_O2 * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * (rControlU_0 - 650.0) * 0.0001) +
                         (rWeightR_Steam * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * (rControlU_1 - 1200.0) * 0.00002) +
                         (rWeightR_Torch * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * (rControlU_2 - 850.0) * 0.0001);
    bMpcInOptimization := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMpcInOptimization := FALSE;
    IF NOT bSystemRunning THEN
        rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 HIGH-TEMPERATURE CERAMIC CANDLE FILTER & PULSED-JET BACKWASH ENGINE                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Models compressible particulate cake deposition (Darcy-Forchheimer law) and manages      *)
(* multi-manifold supersonic reverse pulse-jet blowback sequencing across 4 filter banks.    *)

(* Gas face filtration superficial velocity: v_face = Q_syngas / A_filter *)
(* Syngas actual volumetric flow [m3/s] at operating temperature & pressure *)
IF rVotedVesselPressure_bar > 0.5 THEN
    (* Actual m3/h = Nm3/h * (1.013 / P_bar) * ((T_inlet + 273.15) / 273.15) *)
    (* Face velocity [m/s] = Actual_m3s / A_tube_sheet *)
    rFilterResidualCakeMass_kg := rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg;
END_IF;

(* Integrate continuous flyash/soot particulate deposition *)
IF bSystemRunning AND (rSyngasRawFlowRate_Nm3h > 100.0) THEN
    (* dM_cake = Q_Nm3s * DustLoading_kgNm3 * dt *)
    rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg := rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg +
        ((rSyngasRawFlowRate_Nm3h / 3600.0) * (rDustLoadingInlet_gm3 * 0.001) * rCycleTime_sec);
END_IF;

(* Trigger backwash if dP exceeds threshold OR manual command OR cake mass > 12 kg *)
IF ((rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar >= rFilterDP_HighSetPoint_mbar) OR bManualBackwashTrigger OR (rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg >= 12.0))
   AND NOT bBackwashActive AND (rPulseJetReservoirPress_bar >= rPulseJetReservoirMinPress_bar) AND bSystemRunning THEN
    bBackwashActive := TRUE;
    iFilterBackwashState := 10; (* Start Multi-Manifold Pulsing Sequence *)
    iPulseManifoldIndex := 1;
    rPrePulseFilterDP_mbar := rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Manifold Supersonic Pulse Jet Sequencing Sub-State Machine *)
CASE iFilterBackwashState OF
    0: (* IDLE - No Backwash *)
        bFilterPulseValve1_Cmd := FALSE;
        bFilterPulseValve2_Cmd := FALSE;
        bFilterPulseValve3_Cmd := FALSE;
        bFilterPulseValve4_Cmd := FALSE;
        tPulseDurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
        tBackwashRelaxTimer(IN := FALSE);

    10: (* MANIFOLD 1 PULSE ACTUATION *)
        bFilterPulseValve1_Cmd := TRUE;
        tPulseDurationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180MS); (* 180 ms high-speed burst *)
        IF tPulseDurationTimer.Q THEN
            bFilterPulseValve1_Cmd := FALSE;
            tPulseDurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg := rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg * 0.76; (* 24% mass dislodged *)
            iFilterBackwashState := 15; (* Reservoir recharge dwell *)
        END_IF;

    15: (* RECHARGE DWELL BETWEEN MANIFOLD 1 AND 2 *)
        tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S); (* 4.0 sec reservoir accumulator recharge *)
        IF tPulseIntervalTimer.Q AND (rPulseJetReservoirPress_bar >= rPulseJetReservoirMinPress_bar) THEN
            tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iFilterBackwashState := 20; (* Manifold 2 *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* MANIFOLD 2 PULSE ACTUATION *)
        bFilterPulseValve2_Cmd := TRUE;
        tPulseDurationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180MS);
        IF tPulseDurationTimer.Q THEN
            bFilterPulseValve2_Cmd := FALSE;
            tPulseDurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg := rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg * 0.74;
            iFilterBackwashState := 25;
        END_IF;

    25: (* RECHARGE DWELL BETWEEN MANIFOLD 2 AND 3 *)
        tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF tPulseIntervalTimer.Q AND (rPulseJetReservoirPress_bar >= rPulseJetReservoirMinPress_bar) THEN
            tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iFilterBackwashState := 30; (* Manifold 3 *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* MANIFOLD 3 PULSE ACTUATION *)
        bFilterPulseValve3_Cmd := TRUE;
        tPulseDurationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180MS);
        IF tPulseDurationTimer.Q THEN
            bFilterPulseValve3_Cmd := FALSE;
            tPulseDurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg := rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg * 0.72;
            iFilterBackwashState := 35;
        END_IF;

    35: (* RECHARGE DWELL BETWEEN MANIFOLD 3 AND 4 *)
        tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF tPulseIntervalTimer.Q AND (rPulseJetReservoirPress_bar >= rPulseJetReservoirMinPress_bar) THEN
            tPulseIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iFilterBackwashState := 40; (* Manifold 4 *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* MANIFOLD 4 PULSE ACTUATION *)
        bFilterPulseValve4_Cmd := TRUE;
        tPulseDurationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180MS);
        IF tPulseDurationTimer.Q THEN
            bFilterPulseValve4_Cmd := FALSE;
            tPulseDurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rAccumulatedCakeMass_kg := 0.85; (* Base residual cake retained *)
            iFilterBackwashState := 50; (* Verification & Relaxation *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* POST-BACKWASH RELAXATION & CLEANING EFFICIENCY EVALUATION *)
        tBackwashRelaxTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S); (* Allow hydrodynamic re-stabilization *)
        IF tBackwashRelaxTimer.Q THEN
            tBackwashRelaxTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rPostPulseFilterDP_mbar := rVotedFilterDiffPress_mbar;
            
            (* Check for Candle Blinding: dP did not reduce significantly *)
            IF (rPostPulseFilterDP_mbar > (rPrePulseFilterDP_mbar * 0.88)) AND (rPostPulseFilterDP_mbar > 110.0) THEN
                iBlindingWarningCounter := iBlindingWarningCounter + 1;
                dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Filter cake blinding warning *)
                IF iBlindingWarningCounter >= 3 THEN
                    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Persistent filter blinding trip *)
                END_IF;
            ELSE
                iBlindingWarningCounter := 0;
            END_IF;
            
            (* Check for Candle Rupture / Blowout: dP collapsed below clean membrane *)
            IF (rPostPulseFilterDP_mbar < rFilterDP_RuptureTrip_mbar) AND (rSyngasRawFlowRate_Nm3h > 1200.0) THEN
                dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Candle fracture / soot breakthrough trip *)
            END_IF;
            
            bBackwashActive := FALSE;
            iFilterBackwashState := 0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 MULTI-STAGE MASTER STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;)                       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Complete deterministic operational lifecycle from Cold Standby to Autonomous MPC,         *)
(* Slag Tapping, Candle Backwash, and Emergency Depressurization Flare Sequence.             *)

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: COLD STANDBY / DE-ENERGIZED *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        rInductionCoilPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 0.0; (* Closed *)
        rTapholeCoolingFlowDemand_m3h := 8.0; (* Baseline circulation *)
        
        IF bEnable AND (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#0000_0000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to N2 Inertization *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: VESSEL NITROGEN PURGE & INERTIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0; (* Flare open to vent purged gases *)
        
        (* Purge timer: minimum 3 vessel volume displacements (approx 180s) *)
        tPurgeTimer(IN := bN2PurgePermissive, PT := T#180S);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Refractory Preheat *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: AUXILIARY REFRACTORY PREHEAT (BURNER RAMP TO 850 DEG C) *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0;
        
        (* Wait until vessel refractory exceeds 800 deg C to avoid thermal shock on plasma ignition *)
        IF bAuxBurnerActive AND (rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC >= 800.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Ready for Plasma Arc Ignition *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: PLASMA ARC IGNITION & PILOT STABILIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0;
        
        (* Establish minimum pilot power 450 kW with swirl gas *)
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 450.0;
        tArcIgnitionTimer(IN := (rPlasmaArcCurrent_A > 600.0) AND (rPlasmaArcVoltage_V > 250.0), PT := T#30S);
        IF tArcIgnitionTimer.Q THEN
            tArcIgnitionTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Transition to Hearth Melting & Induction Lining Formation *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: HEARTH MELT & INDUCTION FREEZE-LINING FORMATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 750.0;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0;
        
        (* Soak hearth until slag melts (> 1400 deg C) and protective freeze lining develops *)
        tHearthWarmupTimer(IN := (rVotedHearthSlagTemp_DegC >= 1400.0), PT := T#120S);
        IF tHearthWarmupTimer.Q AND (rEstimatedFreezeLiningThickness_mm >= 15.0) THEN
            tHearthWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Initialize Solid Waste Feed Ramp *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: WASTE FEED RAMP & GASIFICATION INITIALIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 100.0; (* Keep diverted until syngas quality stabilizes *)
        
        (* Ramp waste feeder from 0 to 800 kg/h *)
        IF rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct < 45.0 THEN
            rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct := rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct + (2.5 * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;
        
        (* Provide baseline reactant oxygen and steam *)
        rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := 350.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := 600.0;
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 850.0;
        
        (* When syngas CO + H2 exceeds 50% and freeboard > 1200 deg C, switch to MPC Base Load *)
        IF ((rSyngasCO_Concentration_pct + rSyngasH2_Concentration_pct) >= 50.0) AND (rVotedFreeboardTemp_DegC >= 1200.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Autonomous Base Load Gasification MPC *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: AUTONOMOUS BASE LOAD GASIFICATION (MPC ACTIVE) *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 0.0; (* Syngas clean and routed to ceramic filter & downstream *)
        rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct := 75.0; (* Full nominal feed rate ~1500 kg/h *)
        
        (* MPC Engine actively modulates rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h, rSteamFlowDemand_kgh, rTorchPowerDemand_kW *)
        (* Slag taphole induction freeze-lining actively maintained at 25 mm *)
        (* Ceramic candle filter backwash triggered autonomously on dP / cake resistance *)
        
        (* If user changes target syngas ratio by > 0.2 mol/mol, enter transient ratio optimization *)
        IF ABS(rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol - rTargetSyngasRatio_molmol) > 0.25 THEN
            iState := 70; (* Syngas Ratio Optimization Transient *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 90; (* Controlled Hot Idle Hold *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: SYNGAS STOICHIOMETRIC RATIO TRANSIENT ADAPTATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 0.0;
        
        (* Allow MPC aggressive weights to steer H2/CO ratio back to setpoint *)
        IF ABS(rCalculatedSyngasRatio_molmol - rTargetSyngasRatio_molmol) <= 0.08 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Settled back in base load *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: FILTER BACKWASH SYNCHRONIZED PROCESS DAMPING *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        (* Feedforward trim during filter backwash pressure disturbance *)
        IF NOT bBackwashActive THEN
            iState := 60; (* Return to Base Load *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED HOT IDLE HOLD & DECELERATION *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rWasteFeederSpeedDemand_pct := 0.0; (* Halt waste feed immediately *)
        rFlareDiverterValve_pct := 50.0;   (* Moderate flare divert *)
        
        (* Taper off steam and oxygen *)
        IF rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h > 150.0 THEN
            rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h - (20.0 * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;
        IF rSteamFlowDemand_kgh > 200.0 THEN
            rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := rSteamFlowDemand_kgh - (50.0 * rCycleTime_sec);
        END_IF;
        
        (* Maintain torch at idle power 400 kW to keep hearth molten *)
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 400.0;
        
        IF (rSolidWasteFeedRate_kgh <= 20.0) AND (rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h <= 160.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Returned to Cold Standby *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: EMERGENCY PURGE, FLARE & DEPRESSURIZATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        
        (* Absolute trip commands *)
        rTorchPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rOxygenFlowDemand_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rSteamFlowDemand_kgh := 0.0;
